overall_goal: Measure chocolate buttons and butter into a pan.

goals.description: Retrieve a knife and prepare the chocolate buttons.
goals.rationale: The person gets a knife from the drawer and opens the jar of chocolate buttons to prepare for measuring.

goals.description: Weigh the chocolate buttons into the pan.
goals.rationale: The person pours and carefully adds individual chocolate buttons to reach the desired weight on the scale.

goals.description: Cut and weigh the butter into the pan.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly cuts butter from the dish and adds it to the pan on the scale, then moves the pan to the cooker.
